rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an inconvenience or a troublesome thing; an annoying person is more specifically a 麻煩友.

example.english: Changing the date this time is such a nuisance.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 goi2 kei4 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person who keeps causing annoyance or inconvenience.

example.english: They always borrow things and never return them; they’re such a nuisance.
example.traditional: 佢成日借完嘢唔還，真係個麻煩友。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze3 jyun4 je5 m4 waan4 zan1 hai6 go3 maa4 faan4 jau2

rows.note: Use this formal legal term for a nuisance harmful or offensive to the public or a community member.

example.english: Setting up an illegal stall in the estate passage may constitute a public nuisance.
example.traditional: 喺屋苑通道非法擺檔，可能構成公眾妨擾。
example.jyutping: hai2 uk1 jyun2 tung1 dou6 fei1 faat3 baai2 dong3 ho2 nang4 kau3 sing4 gung1 zung3 fong4 jiu2
